blocks.name: register_file
blocks.design_rationale: Separating the register file allows for easier testing and verification of register operations.

blocks.name: alu
blocks.design_rationale: The ALU is a critical component for executing instructions, and separating it allows for easier testing and verification.

blocks.name: decoder
blocks.responsibility: Decodes the instruction into control signals.
blocks.design_rationale: The decoder is responsible for interpreting the instruction and generating control signals, which makes it easier to verify the correctness of each instruction.

blocks.name: immediate_generator
blocks.design_rationale: Separating the immediate generator allows for easier testing and verification of immediate value generation.

blocks.name: control_unit
blocks.responsibility: Generates control signals based on instruction type.
blocks.design_rationale: The control unit is responsible for generating control signals based on the instruction type, which makes it easier to verify the correctness of each instruction.

blocks.name: cpu_top
blocks.responsibility: Top level entity that instantiates other components and connects them.
blocks.design_rationale: The top level entity is responsible for instantiating other components and connecting them, which makes it easier to verify the correctness of the entire CPU.

notes: The decomposition of the monociclo RV32IM CPU into hardware blocks allows for easier testing and verification of each component. The register_file, alu, decoder, immediate_generator, control_unit, and cpu_top blocks are responsible for storing and retrieving register values, performing arithmetic and logical operations, decoding instructions, generating immediate values, generating control signals based on instruction type, and instantiating other components and connecting them, respectively.
